inspiration: Stardew Valley-inspired warmth, legible daily-life pixel art, expressive characters and tactile interiors, interpreted through Startup Valley’s existing original art.

rules.camera: Fixed elevated screen-aligned orthographic floor; horizontal front edges and vertical height; no diamond/isometric yaw.
rules.lighting: One soft upper-left light direction; stable light and shadow across all facings.
rules.outlines: Crisp approximately one native pixel contours in warm dark brown or material-dark colors; no thick sticker borders, blur or antialiased halo.
rules.pixel_density: Match reference actors and furniture at native scale. Use intentional pixel clusters, not high-resolution painted detail shrunk until noisy.
rules.palette: Coordinated material families: warm oak/walnut, cream paper/fabric, charcoal equipment, muted green foliage. Preserve distinct character palettes and restrained vermilion/indigo accents; do not force every asset into an identical palette.
rules.readability: A recognizable silhouette and purpose at native scale before small details; friendly handcrafted shapes; quiet surfaces leave faces and actions legible.
rules.consistency: Repeat material ramps, contour weight, light direction, scale and camera across assets. Animated frames keep identity, material colors and fixed anchors.
avoid: baked room or character in furniture
copied third-party game sprites or logos
